svg.title: Black Curve X
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Second painting from left in the explicitly captioned 1982 studio photograph. Curved upper edge and downward apex observed. No dimensions reported; normalized approximate frontal study.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://archive.org/download/ellswo00kell/ellswo00kell.pdf#page=68; record guggenheim1996-essay-68-fig-2b; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
